name: towerofhanoi
description: A sleek, responsive, modern 2D Tower of Hanoi web game built with Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Web Audio API.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'www/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('style.css', 'www/style.css'); fs.copyFileSync('script.js', 'www/script.js');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:open: npm run build && npx cap open android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.aab:release: npm run build && npx cap sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease

author: hosursiddharth27
